decisions.reason: The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY that fully captures preservation of reserved entries and replacement of all other blog keywords with the three specified terms.
The source changes blog topic and keyword selections, not the separate keyword research report's keyword count, search-volume requirement, or previously requested report replacements.
Changing selected blog themes does not alter the requirement to deliver nine SEO blog articles.
The blog topic replacement instruction does not change the SEO plan deliverable, its included service areas, or its exclusion of additional work points.
